design.why_replay: The live series is NON-STATIONARY (steward caveat, 2026-10-31): open-PR inflow grew 102 -> 152 in 3 days and NEED_EVIDENCE ballooned on inflow composition, not rule drift. Live-series responses confound tuning effects with inflow mix; frozen snapshots with rules as factors and current rules as control are the clean read.
design.snapshots: ops/ml/pr-lane-feed.json states at the master commits behind the 7 series points (2026-10-28T23:02Z .. 2026-10-31T11:10Z; open 102..152); extraction by the steward lane from feed rows at past master commits.

phases.name: replay_determinism_check
phases.rule: current rules replayed over each snapshot must reproduce the recorded lane distribution exactly; any mismatch halts the campaign and is recorded (the replay harness, not the rules, is then the suspect).

phases.name: baseline_replay
phases.rule: current rules (CONTROL) over all snapshots -> per-PR lane labels joined with covariates (age_days, changed_files, gates, draft, author) and eventual PR outcomes.

phases.name: factorial_replay
phases.rule: rule/threshold levels as factors over the same snapshots. Levels are fixed by a DESIGN AMENDMENT after a firsthand read of the rule files (steward co-review) — never invented in this record. Candidate factor kinds (kinds register): evidence-threshold posture, supersede aggressiveness, minesweeper sensitivity.

phases.name: sibling_candidate
phases.rule: decide.py / laya.py scoring weights (Laya = 0.7*Jev + 0.3*Kev) are the same threshold kind on a live scorer; admitted as a separate campaign if phases 0-2 validate the method.

design.blocking: stratify by covariates (age_days, changed_files, draft, author class) — inflow composition is the known confound.

responses.primary: per-lane outcome-consistency rate on frozen windows: lane assignment vs eventual PR outcome classes (e.g. NEED_EVIDENCE PRs that merged clean with no evidence request = suspected false-NE; SUPERSEDE PRs later merged = suspected false-S).
secondary: inter-variant disagreement rate (the informative subset for adjudication)
lane distribution shift vs control per snapshot

decision_rule.text: A variant level replaces current only if it improves primary outcome-consistency on >= 5 of 7 snapshots with no snapshot regressing beyond the recorded margin, AND the steward lane lands the rule change as its own PR (tuning never edits rules silently; the winning level propagates by cherry-pick per the owner definition).
decision_rule.margin: regression margin fixed in the phase-2 amendment alongside the levels.

registration.note: Design committed before any replay runs. Phase-2 factor levels arrive by amendment (method pre-registered here; parameters read from the rule files, not guessed).
